app.name: DBX
app.one_liner: A lightweight (~15 MB), cross-platform database client supporting 40+ databases with built-in AI-assisted SQL and a rich data grid.

screens.name: Main Query Workspace
screens.purpose: Primary interface for database connections, SQL editing, query execution, and result browsing.

screens.name: Settings & AI Configuration
screens.purpose: Configure database connections, AI models, and application preferences.

rust_commands.name: execute_query
rust_commands.purpose: Run SQL against a connected database and return results with metadata.

rust_commands.name: generate_sql_with_ai
rust_commands.purpose: Send natural language prompt to AI backend and return generated SQL.

rust_commands.name: import_jdbc_driver
rust_commands.purpose: Load offline JDBC driver from ZIP or JAR file.

rust_commands.name: save_snippet
rust_commands.purpose: Persist user SQL snippets for reuse.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add DuckDB and SQLite native connectors
week 1: Build virtual-scrolled result grid with inline editing
week 1: Implement core Tauri + Vue shell with connection management
week 1: Integrate CodeMirror 6 SQL editor with basic autocomplete
week 2: Add AI SQL generation via OpenAI-compatible API
week 2: Implement CSV/JSON export from result grid
week 2: Support saved SQL snippets and query history
acceptance_tests: AI assistant generates valid SQL from natural language input and explains existing queries.
Application remains responsive during normal operations; no unexplained UI freezes.
Offline JDBC driver import works for Snowflake using local JAR file.
Result grid handles 100k+ rows without freezing and allows inline cell editing with SQL preview.
User can connect to a MySQL database and execute a SELECT query without crashes.
